expect: [flat-ipc/preload-direct-invoke] 'provider:getApiKey' is invoked directly by a preload wrapper but is not in validChannels
description: A preload wrapper calls ipcRenderer.invoke with a literal channel that validChannels does not expose (here the retired plaintext-key handler the registry marks unreachable). Reachability must be decided by the allowlist alone, so a direct wrapper around a non-allowlisted channel is a second door and fails.

mutations.append: export const leakProviderKey = (providerId: string) => ipcRenderer.invoke('provider:getApiKey', providerId);
